title: Delayed closing capture of an unclaimed turn adopts the claim held at retry time, attributing turn N's observations to a later turn's work item
outcome: A runtime closing report for a turn that ended without a claim is attributed only to a claim that was the session's binding for that turn. A capture retried after a successor turn has started, or after a claim taken later, never adopts that later claim; the job ends as Unclaimed (or scope-changed) instead.
acceptance: A behavioural test: turn N ends unclaimed; its first closing capture fails transiently and backs off; turn N+1 starts and claims W2; the retried capture for turn N does NOT report to W2 (the job ends Unclaimed or scope-changed), and W2 receives no turn-N commands or check results
A behavioural test: an unclaimed turn whose capture succeeds before any successor turn or later claim still reports as today (no regression for the ordinary case)
The binding a delayed capture adopts is resolved at, or pinned to, the turn's terminal transition, or is accepted only when no successor turn exists and the claim predates the trace's end

completion.summary: Delayed unclaimed closing capture accepts only its original turn's retained opening association, so later claims cannot acquire turn-N observations.
